dict.string: Sayline asks your browser for the page you are reading, so it can share that link when you ask.
Sayline reads your calendar to find the next meeting and its join link. It never creates, edits or deletes events.

Sayline looks up the person you name when you share a page, so it can open the right WhatsApp chat. Contacts are read on your Mac and never sent anywhere.
Sayline needs microphone access to transcribe your speech into text.
Sayline needs access to Reminders so you can create and cancel them by voice.
